choice.basis: The dashboard shows May's bar is dramatically lower than every other month (well below the 10,000 kWh gridline, while all other months are at or above 17,000 kWh). However, no printed critical threshold, escalation criterion, or routing legend is visible on the chart or provided in the task context. Record r1's reasoning (standard follow-up absent a stated critical rule) is supported, while record r2's escalation reasoning is refuted because it relies on an unstated policy condition. Without an explicit rule defining 'critical' severity, the low value alone supports standard low-usage follow-up.
choice.option_label: Route May to standard low-usage follow-up
